name: Claude Code
summary: Anthropic's agentic coding tool, available in the terminal, IDEs, a desktop app and the browser.

skills.what: Skills: SKILL.md files that follow the Agent Skills open standard, with Claude Code extensions to the frontmatter.

mcp.what: MCP servers as local stdio processes or remote servers over HTTP, SSE or WebSocket.

sources.title: Connect Claude Code to tools via MCP

plugins.what: Claude Code plugins: a directory with a .claude-plugin/plugin.json manifest bundling skills, agents, hooks, MCP servers and other components, installed from marketplaces.

hooks.what: Hooks: shell commands, prompts or agents that run at points in Claude Code's lifecycle such as before a tool call; settings and plugins can declare them.

scheduled-work.what: Scheduled tasks: cloud scheduled tasks (formerly routines, research preview) run on a schedule, an API call or GitHub events; Desktop scheduled tasks run while the app is open; /loop and the cron tools repeat prompts within a session.

sources.title: Schedule recurring tasks in Claude Code Desktop

sandboxes.what: The sandboxed Bash tool limits the files and network hosts shell commands can reach on macOS, Linux and WSL2; on native Windows, commands run unsandboxed.
